checks.degree_identity: The department explicitly identifies a Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Science; current linked course catalogs label 2026–27.
checks.required_and_choices: Manually enumerated 20 prescribed identities; 28 named options comprise 3 linear alternatives, 9 depth options, 12 general elective options and 4 writing alternatives. The note-root defect is corrected.
checks.elective_pools: Depth requires at least 12 semester hours; general AI/ML/DS electives require at least 21 and permit an open CSE 100+ range. HSS, additional science and free electives remain source-defined open predicates; no finite list is fabricated.
checks.prerequisites: Read every listed course block. Prerequisite/corequisite conditions are metadata only, not new degree obligations. CSE 017 and other prerequisites outside the displayed core remain explicit enrollment applicability questions.
checks.credits_and_units: Undergraduate catalog explicitly defines semester hours. Degree table and sample totals disagree (130–131 versus 130; free electives 11 versus 10). Grouped physics/linear amounts were not assigned to each alternative. Variable course-catalog amounts remain nullable; degree-specific amounts retain their scope.
checks.classification: All 48 identities independently reviewed from authoritative descriptions: 44 reviewed primary subjects and 4 mixed. No prefix or degree-membership classification.
checks.family_composition: Standalone degree; no inherited family requirements.
checks.degree_wide_requirements: Previously mapped university and college policies remain; this pass reread basic HSS and unit/prerequisite rules. Whole-degree certification is blocked by source conflicts and unresolved overlapping CSE eligibility.

discrepancies.issue: A note ancestor hid all prescribed and option course roles.
discrepancies.correction: Required root is all; depth/general pools are source-backed credit choices.

discrepancies.issue: Legacy subjects conflated algorithms for AI, data systems, ethics and statistical methods.
discrepancies.correction: 48 manual description-based category reviews; four mixed courses remain other.

blockers.issue: Department table and sample plan disagree on total and free-elective credits; no authoritative reconciliation.
Required/depth reuse inside the open CSE 100+ elective allocation is not explicitly resolved; some listed options require non-core prerequisites with no documented blanket substitution.

programs.correction_status: Role and all 48 course-subject corrections applied; source conflicts preserved.
